messages.subject: Accounts page seems to display secondary email address from my Github account and not the Primary email
parts:
Hi, I just set up my account on shinyapps.io connecting it with my github account. On both sites my username is jeffreyhorner.

Somehow, on the shinyapps Accounts page, it picked up my secondary email address rather than my primary email from gmail. I've since deleted my secondary email address on github.

So, can the accounts page reveal my primary email and not any other? How does this field get populated? Is it a concern at all?

Thanks,

Jeff
